title: SCA Tish'a BeAb 2022: Rabbi Richard Tobias

chapters.title: Reasons for the destruction of the Bet HaMikdash
The root cause in Sefer Yirmiyahu
The consequence of foreign values
chapters.about: Ki Tabo, Rabbi Shimshon Raphael Hirsch, education

chapters.title: Three steps to return to our moral compass

summary: Rabbi Tobias explores the underlying causes for the destruction of the Bet HaMikdash, moving beyond the list of specific sins to the root issue of treating Torah as an intellectual occupation rather than a core identity. He discusses how this shift in perspective leaves individuals vulnerable to societal challenges and emphasizes the need to cultivate confidence, love, and active living of Torah to ensure continuity.
questions: Why was the Bet HaMikdash destroyed?
What does it mean to make Torah your being rather than your occupation?
How can we withstand modern societal challenges to our values?
Why is it important to say Berachot before learning Torah?
How do we effectively teach Torah values to our children?
